title: Apex - Tactical Ops
description: Live tactical KPIs: friendly/enemy strength, readiness, morale, combat effectiveness, casualty rate/trend, and mission progress. Queries assume analytics snapshots are persisted to a `tactical_kpis` hypertable/table (see grafana/README or the analytics engine in server/analytics/engine.js for the field definitions).

targets.rawSql: SELECT friendly_strength AS value FROM tactical_kpis ORDER BY generated_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT enemy_strength AS value FROM tactical_kpis ORDER BY generated_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT combat_effectiveness AS value FROM tactical_kpis ORDER BY generated_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT mission_progress AS value FROM tactical_kpis ORDER BY generated_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT generated_at AS time, friendly_readiness AS "Readiness", friendly_morale AS "Morale" FROM tactical_kpis WHERE $__timeFilter(generated_at) ORDER BY generated_at
SELECT generated_at AS time, casualty_rate AS "Casualty Rate (per min)" FROM tactical_kpis WHERE $__timeFilter(generated_at) ORDER BY generated_at
